# owner: platform
"""Contact sheet rows for substitute teachers."""

from typing import List
from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError


def contact_row(student: Student) -> str:
    """Aligned row for one student. Needs an email."""
    name, section = student.display_name, student.section
    if not student.email:
        raise ProjectError(f"no email for {name}")
    return f"{name:<24} {section:<10} {student.email}"


def contact_rows(students: List[Student]) -> List[str]:
    """Sorted by name. Empty input raises."""
    if not students:
        raise ProjectError("no students to list")
    ordered = sorted(
        students, key=lambda item: item.display_name
    )
    return [contact_row(student) for student in ordered]

# owner: platform
"""Tests for the substitute teacher contact sheet."""

import unittest
from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.contacts import contact_rows


class ContactRowsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.students = [
            Student(
                "3", "Varrow", "Ines", "B",
                "ines@example.invalid"
            ),
            Student(
                "2", "Thistle", "Bram", "A",
                "bram@example.invalid"
            ),
            Student(
                "1", "Quill", "Sefa", "A",
                "sefa@example.invalid"
            )
        ]

    def test_rows_sorted_by_display_name(self):
        rows = contact_rows(self.students)
        names = [row[:24].strip() for row in rows]
        expected = [
            "Quill, Sefa",
            "Thistle, Bram",
            "Varrow, Ines"
        ]
        self.assertEqual(names, expected)

    def test_email_column_lines_up(self):
        rows = contact_rows(self.students)
        # 24 name, 10 section, two spaces
        emails = [row[36:] for row in rows]
        expected = [
            "sefa@example.invalid",
            "bram@example.invalid",
            "ines@example.invalid"
        ]
        self.assertEqual(emails, expected)

    def test_missing_email_names_the_student(self):
        cole = Student("4", "Cole", "Ray", "B")
        self.students.append(cole)
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError) as caught:
            contact_rows(self.students)
        self.assertIn("Cole, Ray", str(caught.exception))

    def test_empty_list_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            contact_rows([])
